list.a: Yes, both our ceremony and reception are outdoor affairs. The ceremony and lawn areas are situated on grass, so we highly recommend wearing footwear suitable for grass, such as block heels, wedges, or dressy flats.
list.q: Is the wedding outdoors? What shoes are recommended?

list.a:
Welcome Party: Desert Casual
Think elevated poolside style with a relaxed, breezy feel. Lightweight fabrics, sundresses, linen sets, polished resort wear, and comfortable footwear are all welcome. Feel free to bring a swimsuit if you'd like to take a dip—we'd love to see guests enjoying the pool! Stylish cover-ups, matching sets, and other chic poolside attire are encouraged.

Wedding Day: Desert Formal
Sophisticated and elegant attire inspired by the desert landscape. We invite gentlemen to wear suits in lighter colors, earthy tones, or lightweight fabrics (black tie is not required). We invite ladies to wear elegant cocktail dresses, midi dresses, or floor-length gowns. Block heels, wedges, or other footwear suitable for outdoor walking are recommended.

Desert Weather Tip
While afternoons are warm and sunny, desert temperatures can drop quickly after sunset. We highly recommend bringing a light layer—such as a wrap, shawl, or blazer—to stay comfortable once the stars come out.

The estate does not have guest parking available on-site, so we kindly ask guests to arrive via rideshare services like Uber or Lyft. However, exceptions will be made for brief drop-offs (such as families with small children or guests requiring wheelchair/accessibility access). If you need to make drop-off arrangements, please let us know in advance.

list.a: Little ones are welcome at our ceremony, but the welcome party and reception will be adults-only. Don't worry—we're planning to arrange babysitting services so parents can enjoy the festivities. More information will be provided closer to the big day.
